rows.name: Humana
rows.thesis: The 2027 star-ratings blowout resets bonus revenue above Street models, and UNH's Q3 showed no cost spike. Tuesday's drop was a group fade with no Humana news.
rows.exit: Humana closes below $410, CMS recalculates the 2027 star ratings, or Elevance, Molina or Centene flags a medical-cost or utilization spike.

rows.name: Goldman Sachs
rows.thesis: The print cleared both exit metrics after a 10% one-month selloff. Drift is the remaining upside, but the first-day reversal and BAC's weak trading cut the expected drift.
rows.exit: Goldman closes below $850, or the US 10-year yield rises above 5.4%.

rows.name: GE Vernova
rows.thesis: Expectations reset after the Q2 miss while power orders keep compounding. The Oct 28 report is the dated catalyst, separate from the bank, managed-care and optics bets.
rows.exit: GE Vernova closes below $950 before Oct 28, or cuts orders or free-cash-flow guidance.

rows.name: Coherent
rows.thesis: Coherent shares the AI-optics demand Lumentum calls sold out to 2029, at a lower multiple. The pressure is AI-capex sentiment, not a demand or pricing warning; it is the book's first tail name.
rows.exit: Coherent guides below consensus, Lumentum warns on demand or pricing, or COHR closes below $262.

rows.name: Penguin Solutions
rows.thesis: The cleanest beat-and-raise in the drift scan, with targets rising after Oct 6. Its memory exposure ties it to the CXMT scare; it is the book's second tail name.
rows.exit: Penguin closes below $72.61, cuts guidance, or announces an equity offering.

rows.name: Devon Energy
rows.thesis: The team's oil hedge against a Hormuz escalation. Escalation continues; the desk holds it as entered.
rows.exit: A signed US-Iran deal reopens Hormuz, or Devon closes below $46.12.

rows.name: SpaceX
rows.thesis: The team's small high-volatility bet on SpaceX. The desk holds it as entered; the lockup supply is the near-term risk.
